comment: Shared contract between internal/jevnotices (Go, canonical) and gateway/jev_notice.py (Python twin). Each case is one notice record and the exact line BOTH implementations must produce. Both sides' tests execute this table.

cases.name: goal-intent task success first attempt
cases.expect: 🔎 jev goal-intent (attempt 1/2) user message from Alice: task (confidence 0.82)

cases.name: goal-intent chat label is visible
cases.expect: 🔎 jev goal-intent (attempt 1/2) user message from Alice: chat (confidence 0.20)

cases.name: goal-intent transport failure on first attempt
cases.expect: 🔎 jev goal-intent (attempt 1/2) user message from Alice: failed (transport_error)

cases.name: goal-intent schema failure detail collapses to class token
cases.expect: 🔎 jev goal-intent (attempt 2/2) user message from Bob: failed (schema_mismatch)

cases.name: goal-intent without author omits the fragment
response-gate allow with all four nouls
cases.expect: 🔎 jev response-gate user message from Alice: allow (addresses_bot=0.91 continues_bot_thread=0.12 joins_bot_thread=0.03 noise=0.05)

cases.name: response-gate deny below threshold is visible
cases.expect: 🔎 jev response-gate user message from Tek: deny (addresses_bot=0.09 continues_bot_thread=0.88 joins_bot_thread=0.02 noise=0.75)

cases.name: response-gate http failure after a real request
cases.expect: 🔎 jev response-gate user message from Tek: failed (http_502)

cases.name: response-gate timeout failure
cases.expect: 🔎 jev response-gate user message from Tek: failed (timeout)

cases.name: reaction-gate react with abstention mass
cases.expect: 🔎 jev reaction-gate user message from Alice: react 🔥 (abstain 0.20)

cases.name: reaction-gate no-reaction abstention is visible
cases.expect: 🔎 jev reaction-gate user message from Alice: no reaction (abstain 0.63)

cases.name: reaction-gate judge failure
cases.expect: 🔎 jev reaction-gate user message from Tek: failed (incoherent_distribution)

cases.name: hostile author name cannot ping or format
cases.expect: 🔎 jev response-gate user message from everyone code injection: allow (addresses_bot=0.90 continues_bot_thread=0.10 joins_bot_thread=0.00 noise=0.10)

cases.name: single-attempt caller hides the attempt fragment
cases.expect: 🔎 jev reaction-gate user message from Tek: react 👍 (abstain 0.10)
